lead.description: the average that replaces each observation by its reciprocal, then takes the reciprocal of the arithmetic mean of those reciprocals

self_checks.title: Three interest rates
self_checks.prompt: Rates of 5%, 10% and 15% produce the same income. What is the harmonic mean, as an exact fraction, and what is the arithmetic mean?
self_checks.answer: The harmonic mean is 90/11 percent, about 8.182. The arithmetic mean is 10 percent.

self_checks.title: Three weights
self_checks.prompt: Person weights are 100, 200 and 300. What is the exact harmonic mean, and what integer does it round to?
self_checks.answer: The exact value is 1800/11, about 163.636, which rounds to 164.

self_checks.title: A zero
self_checks.prompt: One of six positive observations is replaced by zero. What happens to the harmonic mean?
self_checks.answer: The harmonic mean is undefined, because a reciprocal of zero is not a number.

overview_sentence: The [harmonic mean](articles/harmonic-mean.qmd) is the reciprocal average of the reciprocals, used for rates and prices with a fixed outlay.
